PRINT SPECS
Trim 3.5 x 2 in (US standard). Artboards are 1050 x 600 px, which is 300 dpi at trim size, so a PNG export of each face is press-ready.

Send to the printer with 0.125 in bleed (3.75 x 2.25 in) - the black background and the blue left bar run to the edge, so the printer can pull them out. Nothing important sits closer than 0.125 in to the trim.

Finish: matte or soft-touch black stock, with the blue in spot gloss or foil, gets closest to the reference card.

PLACEHOLDERS TO REPLACE
- [@HANDLE] on the back: the real Instagram handle.
- The QR code encodes https://soflodetail.com. It scans, but swap it for whatever booking URL you want on the card.
- The car mark is a rebuild, not the original logo file. Drop the real SoFlo Shine artwork in before printing.
